prompt: Generate a high-fidelity desktop website mockup for Shun Ren's personal portfolio, edge-to-edge landscape viewport, readable text, no browser frame. It should work as a personal site and for resume evaluation, with conventional sans-serif typography and straightforward navigation. Visible exact content: 'Shun Ren', 'Singapore-based security & software engineer'; navigation 'Home', 'About me', 'Projects'; 'My Skills' with 'Python', 'HTML', 'Nessus Essentials'; 'My Projects' with 'Space Invaders-like game' and 'Spotify Time Machine'; 'Get In Touch', 'Contact me'. No invented claims, experience, availability, employment, or metrics. Composition B, Town promenade: a continuous calm left reading column with name and role followed by compact skill rows and two substantial project rows. An atmospheric illustration of a snow-covered pedestrian street recedes along the far right edge and curves behind the opening, giving the page depth without becoming a text background. This is a believable near-future Zakopane-like small town: traditional timber architecture lightly modernized with glass, snow-covered pines, a mountain backdrop, amber-lit cafes and tiny cyan transit signs. It feels warm, positive, inhabited and peaceful. Use deep alpine blue with warm white reading text, amber light and very restrained cyan links. Keep projects and personal information dominant, plenty of negative space. The architecture lives mostly at the perimeter; no dense billboards, no megatowers, no gothic forms, no terminal UI, no sci-fi gauges, no tiny decorative status text. Show the beginning of lower content to establish a real website rather than a scenic poster.
purpose: Visual proposal only; generated copy and thumbnails are not approved content.
